regulations.notes: As of late 2025, Eagle County has declined to impose strict STR licensing for unincorporated areas and is taking a 'light-touch' approach, collecting data but no full licensing ordinance. Municipalities within Eagle County (Vail, Avon, Eagle, Gypsum, Basalt) have their own separate regulations. County may revisit a full licensing ordinance in the future. This applies to unincorporated areas such as Edwards and Beaver Creek.
regulations.pending_legislation: Full licensing ordinance possible in future
